company.name: Pindrop
company.shortDescription: Pindrop uses AI-based IVR authentication and anti-fraud solutions to increase efficiency in call centers and stop fraudulent transactions.
company.description: Pindrop is propelling enterprises and consumers toward a voice-driven future by unlocking the value of every voice interaction. Interacting with a financial institution, a digital assistant, a video chat, or a smart device can provide access to our unique identity, and open new capabilities not possible without proper security or intelligence evoked solely from a voice.

productsAndServices.description: AI-based deepfake detection for voice and video interactions. It identifies synthetic voices and video participants in contact centers and virtual meetings using liveness and anomaly analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Pindrop® Pulse

productsAndServices.description: A fraud detection solution that evaluates calls in near real time and generates fraud-risk assessments to help organizations identify suspicious activity and protect customer accounts.
productsAndServices.name: Pindrop® Protect

productsAndServices.description: A passive, multifactor caller-authentication solution that evaluates voice, device, and behavioral signals to verify customers without requiring additional steps from legitimate callers.
productsAndServices.name: Pindrop® Passport

productsAndServices.description: An AI-assisted investigation service that helps fraud teams analyze phone-fraud cases, prioritize investigative work, and resolve cases more efficiently.
productsAndServices.name: Fraud Assist

productsAndServices.description: Call-risk assessment technology that evaluates voice and other interaction signals without interrupting the agent or customer experience.
productsAndServices.name: VeriCall® Technology
